reviews.title: My skin gets oily after applying this.
reviews.body: I have acne-prone skin, and after applying this sunscreen over my moisturizer, my skin tends to become oily. However, the sunscreen itself works well and provides good protection. If you have oily or acne-prone skin, you may want to consider using a lightweight or gel-based moisturizer underneath.
